    @allure.title("Verify that the Discuss panel loads without unexpected browser console errors")
    @allure.description("Reloads the panel while listening for console errors and confirms no unexpected errors are raised, aside from the pre-existing unrelated eula-banner.js MIME-type warning.")
    @pytest.mark.priority(41)
    def test_no_unexpected_console_errors_on_load(self):
    	console_errors = []
    	self.page.on("console", lambda msg: console_errors.append(msg.text) if msg.type == "error" else None)
    	self.page.reload()
    	self.team._wait_for_discuss_feed()
    	unexpected_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "eula-banner.js" not in e]
